events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict between the US and Iran is escalating, with potential for a regional war. This could lead to a significant increase in oil prices and market volatility.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the conflict could lead to a surge in oil prices, which would negatively impact the global economy and lead to a decrease in bond yields. This would make the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) a good buy, while the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) would be a good short.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or the conflict de-escalates
